title: observability: token-kv metrics + tracing dashboard updates and alert tuning
author: Aisha Kumar
release_notes: Adds token-level KV cache and request-level tracing metrics, updates Grafana dashboards, and tunes alerts for reduced false positives.
description:
Summary: Add token-level KV cache metrics, expand tracing spans for inference hot paths, update Grafana dashboards with new panels (token cost/latency breakdowns and per-model KV hit heatmaps), and tune alert thresholds to reduce noise while preserving SLO coverage.
Motivation: Recent support incidents showed increased tail latency during multi-tenant bursts and noisy alerts on cache miss spikes. We need better observability at token granularity and more signal in tracing to root-cause where latency/cost regressions happen.
Changes:
1) Metrics:
- Added new Prometheus metrics: redwood_kv_token_requests_total, redwood_kv_token_hits_total, redwood_token_cost_microtokens_total, redwood_token_latency_microseconds_bucket (histogram)
- Exposed per-model and per-route labels (model_name, route, tier) for downstream aggregation
2) Tracing:
- Added new spans around KV lookup, KV deserialization, batch scheduling, and kernel selection with attributes for sequence_length and cached_prefix_bytes
- Ensure trace IDs are propagated through async batch queues
3) Dashboards:
- New panels: Token cost breakdown (prompt vs completion vs cache), Token latency percentiles by model and route, KV hit-rate heatmap, Tracing waterfall sample viewer
- Reorganized the inference observability dashboard to group token metrics and KV metrics side-by-side
4) Alert tuning:
- Adjusted existing alerts: KV-miss-spike -> now fires at 15m sustained + anomaly scoring to suppress short bursts; Token-latency-p99 -> increased alert window and added service-level grouping; Cost-anomaly -> moved to warning severity for hostless tenants
- Added runbooks linking from alert tiles to the new dashboard and root-cause checklist
Commits (high level):
- a1b2c3d: metrics: add token-level kv and cost metrics

Files changed (high level):
- pkg/observability/metrics.go: new metrics and label plumbing
- pkg/observability/tracing.go: spans and propagation helpers
- internal/grafana/dashboards/inference-token-kv.json: new dashboard JSON (small panels trimmed for PR)
- internal/alerts/inference_alerts.yaml: tuned alert rules and runbook links
- pkg/serving/batching/scheduler.go: minor trace propagation change
- tests/*_metrics_test.go: unit tests and mock registry
- docs/runbooks/kv-miss.md: runbook for KV-miss incident
Review conversation: Marco Li (2024-11-13): "Nice set of metrics — can we avoid cardinality explosion on route label?" Author (Aisha Kumar) (2024-11-13): "Good call. Route is coarse-grained (service name) and we add tier+model_name; also capped custom_route label to top 100 via sampled label strategy, documented in metrics.go." Sofia Patel (2024-11-14): "Tracing looks good, but I saw missing context propagation in the async worker path — tests caught it. Can you add integration test?" Author (2024-11-15): "Added integration test and fixed propagation in scheduler.go; expanded test matrix for sequence_length label edge cases." Ethan Park (2024-11-16): "Alert tuning looks reasonable; curious about false positives historically — can we add an anomaly scoring note in the runbook?" Author (2024-11-16): "Added anomaly scoring explanation and example graphs to runbook. Also set KV-miss alert to warning for non-production tenants." CI summary: - CI run 1 (2024-11-14): failed (flaky metrics test), rerun triggered - CI run 2 (2024-11-15): pass after test fix - Dashboard JSON validation: pass - Load test (nightly): no regression detected in p50/p99 latency
Merge: Squash merge performed by Aisha Kumar on 2024-11-20.
Post-merge actions:
- Rolled dashboard to staging Grafana; will promote to prod after 48h of monitoring
- Created a follow-up ticket ENG-2401 to add an opt-in high-cardinality debugging mode for customers with advanced needs
Notes and considerations:
- Kept metric label set conservative to control Prometheus cardinality; used sampled labels and relabeled at ingestion for high-cardinality route_tag
- Dashboard JSON intentionally excludes full panel queries to keep PR reviewable; ops will pick up full queries during rollout
- No breaking API changes.
